body.description: The current step's data: exactly the fields `GET /v1/onboardings/{id}/state` lists as active, validated against its `step.schema`. There is no fixed shape; the workflow decides, so the body is passed to the step validator untouched and an unknown field is refused rather than dropped. A field an asynchronous connector writes on its callback (a KYC verdict, its attempt count) is refused as `CALLBACK_ONLY`: only the provider decides it.
